purpose: isolated independent left/right mitten hand concept generation
approval_boundary: Trial15 size direction only is user-approved. These generated pixels and this trial are not approved.
automated_observations: Both PNGs are RGB color type 2; neither carries alpha/transparency.
ImageMagick identify reports 1024x1024 srgb and 912x1150 srgb respectively.

human_visual_review.positive_observation: Inward-facing thumb nubs appear on the requested inner edges; contours are not exact mirrored duplicates.
failure_observations: Both images show long narrow wrist/forearm shafts relative to the compact hand target, ending in blunt visible top cuts.
Opaque checkerboard-pattern backgrounds make neither output a transparent part.
Uniform heavy plum outlines and smooth broad gradients do not match the registered Chibi source's finer, softer line/shadow treatment.
human_visual_review.decision: Reject; retain as negative evidence only. Do not matte-remove, chroma-key, source-fit, rig, or promote these images.

remaining_gap: Compliant source-aligned left/right mitten art with genuine hidden-wrist continuation, followed by source-cuff review and required user/artist approval.
